blocks.html: MUSICAL STARS SPARKLE ONSTAGE AT ROBINSONS MALLS

The Christmas spirit continues to fill the air as Robinsons Malls spreads cheer to shoppers during the most wonderful time of the year. Whatever kind of music you fancy - be it rock, bossa nova, R&amp;B, pop, or jazz - these upcoming musical shows are sure to get you in the mood for Christmas and you’ll be dancing, singing, and tapping to the Christmas beat in no time!

Ely Buendia, best known for his stint as frontman of the popular 90s band Eraserheads, leads the roster of artists performing live at Robinsons Malls this December. Rock to the beat of Ely’s most popular hits, and get ready for some surprise yuletide cheer too. It’s just the right dash of joy you need for a very merry Christmas!

Swing and sway to bossa nova tunes when Sitti takes the stage with that distinctive voice. Dubbed as the Queen of Bossa Nova, Sitti is best known for her “bossafied” pop covers as well as a number of original songs including “A Song for Penny Brown.” A few years back, she also released her first Christmas album, Ngayong Pasko, which features a collaboration with Christian Bautista in the classic yuletide song, “Baby, It’s Cold Outside” – perfect for this chilly season!

For well-loved, all-time favorites, listen to The CompanY, with their voices blending beautifully to render almost all forms of music genres: dance, contemporary a capella, alternative pop, and of course, Christmas music, among others. Watch out, too, for the group’s experimental approach with their costumes and stage act - truly a reflection of their award-winning talent and versatility!

Catch the rising talent from Cebu, Morissette Amon, and witness the impressive vocal range that drew the attention of the judges in various talent shows on television. Morissette has come into her own, impressing a wider audience with her pop, R&amp;B, soul, dance, and OPM renditions. Watch her wow audiences this yuletide season!

If you’re in the mood for OPM ballads and soulful covers, Juris is the one to look out for. Juris has made a name for herself since her days as MYMP’s lead vocalist. Her renditions of the most romantic songs will surely make you fall in love all over again this Christmas.

Make sure you’re at the front row when Ely Buendia, Sitti, The CompanY, Morissette Amon, and Juris take the stage this Christmas. Take note of the following dates and catch these dazzling musical stars at Robinsons Malls!
Sitti Navarro performs onstage at Robinsons Metro East on Dec 12 at 4pm, Robinsons Place Lipa on Dec 13 at 5pm, and Robinsons Place Las Piñas on Dec 19 at 5pm.
The Company will serenade audiences at Robinsons Place Manila on Dec 12, Robinsons Magnolia on Dec 13, and Robinsons Galleria on Dec 18. Shows start at 5pm.

Juris Fernandez will sing best-loved hits at Robinsons Place Imus on Dec 6, Robinsons Place Antipolo on Dec 12, Robinsons Place Malolos on Dec 13, and Robinsons Place Angeles on Dec 20. Shows start at 5pm.
MorisetteAmon will be onstage at Forum Robinsons on Dec 6, Robinsons Sta. Rosa on Dec 12, and Robinsons Place Dasmariñas on Dec 13. Shows start at 5pm.
